Astana Football Club is a professional football club based in Astana. They compete in the Kazakhstan Premier League, the highest tier of Kazakh football. The club's home ground is the 30,000-seat Astana Arena stadium. The club colours, reflected in their badge and kit, are sky blue and yellow. Founded as Lokomotiv Astana in 2009, the club changed its name to Astana in 2011.
